<div class="card-body">
'''Ellorrs Madak''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">エローズ・マダック</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：ドロイドを除く、パイロットでないキャラクターに配備し、パイロット技能</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-49o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デュロスの常として、マダックも生まれつき操縦、航法術の腕ききだ。昔は偵察員で今はフリーの操縦コーチ。セラノン、バイブローズ、ヤガ・マイナーといった要所を駆けめぐる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Ellorrs Madak.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Deploy on a non-pilot character other than a droid and give that character pilot skill. A starship that character pilots is power +2. 2. Deploy on a pilot and add a further 1 to the power of a starship the character pilots. Immune to Alter.

'''Lore:''' Like other Duros, Madak is a natural at piloting and navigation. Formerly a scout, he is now a freelance flight instructor who travels between places such as Seranon, Byblos, and Yaga Minor.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Ellorrs Madak]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
